_comment: model=null uses your Claude Code default. strict_mcp_isolation passes --strict-mcp-config with an empty --mcp-config so ambient mimir does not leak into control/static. 'arms' is the DEFAULT subset run; the full registry also has 'grounded' (Phase 4 evidence-grounded retrieval) and 'mimir_sys' (top-1 clean), opt in via --arms. 'mimir_agentic' is de-scoped (not registered). See README 'Seams' before first run.
